sso.claimFailed.body: You are signed in. Link {provider} again from your account settings.
sso.claimFailed.title: {provider} could not be linked
sso.claimHint: Sign in to your KROMA account once, and {provider} will be linked to it.
sso.elsewhere.body: Go back to the browser tab where you started, or start again from the sign-in screen.
sso.elsewhere.title: This sign-in was started somewhere else
sso.emailTaken.body: An account on {server} uses the same email address. Sign in to it once to link {provider}.
sso.emailTaken.title: You already have an account here
sso.expired.body: Start again from the sign-in screen.
sso.expired.title: This sign-in has expired
sso.failed.body: {provider} and this server could not complete the sign-in. Try again, and tell an administrator if it keeps happening.
sso.failed.title: The sign-in did not go through
sso.failedDenied.title: Sign-in cancelled
sso.flowExpired: This sign-in has expired. Go back to KROMA and try again
sso.identityUnknown: This sign-in is not linked to your account
sso.invitationOnly.body: Ask an administrator of {server} for an invitation link, then choose {provider} on that page.
sso.invitationOnly.title: This server is invitation only
sso.issuerInvalid: The provider address must be https, or a host on the local network
sso.labelInvalid: Give the provider a name of 40 characters or fewer
sso.lastWayIn: This is your only way to sign in. Add another one before removing it
sso.linkedElsewhere: This sign-in already belongs to another account
sso.originInvalid: This address is not one the server accepts sign-ins from
sso.passkeysOff: Passkey sign-in is turned off on this server
sso.passwordNeedsProvider: Test a sign-in provider before turning passwords off
sso.passwordOff: Password sign-in is turned off on this server
sso.providerInvalid: One of the provider's fields is not valid
sso.providerUnknown: This sign-in provider is not available
sso.providerUnreachable: The sign-in provider could not be reached
sso.reason.discovery.address: The address must be https, or a host on the local network.
sso.reason.discovery.algorithm: The provider signs with an algorithm this server refuses. Give the application a signing key, so it signs with RS256, ES256, ES384 or EdDSA.
sso.reason.discovery.endpoint: The provider lists an address this server will not call: plain http outside the local network.
sso.reason.discovery.issuerMismatch: The provider describes another issuer than the address you typed.
sso.reason.discovery.noDocument: The address answers, but it serves no OpenID Connect discovery document. Check the issuer URL.
sso.reason.discovery.noKeys: The provider's signing keys could not be read.
sso.reason.discovery.unreadable: The provider's discovery document could not be read.
sso.reason.exchange.invalid_client: The provider refused the client ID or the client secret.
sso.reason.exchange.invalid_grant: The provider refused the sign-in code. Check that the redirect URI is registered exactly as shown.
sso.reason.exchange.noIdToken: The provider returned no ID token. The application must be an OpenID Connect one.
sso.reason.exchange.unreachable: The provider did not answer when the server came back for the tokens.
sso.reason.provider.access_denied: The sign-in was cancelled at the provider.
sso.reason.provider.changed: The provider's settings changed during the sign-in. Try again.
sso.reason.token.algorithm: The provider signs with an algorithm this server refuses. Choose RS256, ES256, ES384 or EdDSA, with a signing key.
sso.reason.token.audience: The ID token was issued for another client ID.
sso.reason.token.expired: The ID token had already expired. Check the clock of this server and of the provider.
sso.reason.token.issuer: The ID token names another issuer than the provider's address.
sso.reason.token.nonce: The ID token answers another sign-in than the one that was started.
sso.reason.token.signature: The ID token's signature does not match the provider's keys.
sso.reason.token.unknownKey: The ID token is signed with a key the provider does not publish.
sso.refused.blocked.body: An administrator of {server} declined your request to join.
sso.refused.blocked.title: Your request was declined
sso.refused.full.body: Ask an administrator of {server} to go through the join requests, then try again.
sso.refused.full.title: Too many people are waiting
sso.refused.group.body: Your account at {provider} is not in a group that {server} lets in.
sso.refused.group.title: You are not on the list
sso.refused.inviteInvalid.body: Ask an administrator of {server} for a new invitation link.
sso.refused.inviteInvalid.title: This invitation is no longer valid
sso.refused.linkedElsewhere.body: This {provider} sign-in already belongs to another account on {server}.
sso.refused.linkedElsewhere.title: Already linked to another account
sso.refused.noEmail.body: {provider} did not share an email address, and an account on {server} needs one.
sso.refused.noEmail.title: An email address is missing
sso.requestUnknown: This join request no longer exists
sso.requested.body: An administrator of {server} has to approve it. Sign in again with {provider} once they have.
sso.requested.title: Your request has been sent
sso.tooManyFlows: Too many sign-ins in progress. Try again in a few minutes
sso.tooManyProviders: A server takes 8 sign-in providers at most
